text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: The paper is a non-review research article that explicitly focuses on national-scale LULC prediction for Afghanistan using the Dynamic Land System (DLS) model coupled with linear programming. The study uses GlobeLand30 data for 2000, 2010, and 2020 as baseline inputs, applies spatial modeling, reports quantitative accuracy metrics (Kappa = 0.78, overall accuracy = 89%), and produces mapped LULC projections for the entire country. All core inclusion criteria are met, and no exclusion criteria apply.)
